title: Microsoft Teams: new chat sections for muted and meeting chats
summary: The defaults, rollout targets, affected users and absence of tenant controls agree with Microsoft's notice and roadmap. The Graph beta statements are documented. One descriptive sentence extends the notice's drag-and-drop behaviour from sections to chats without supporting evidence.

claims.claim: Teams is introducing system sections named Muted chats and Meeting chats.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams is introducing two new system chat sections called Muted chats and Meeting chats.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The change arrives without admin action, with Muted chats enabled by default, supporting defaultState on.
claims.quote: Muted chats section- Enabled by default.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The Meeting chats section is disabled by default.
claims.quote: Meeting chats section- Disabled by default.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Users can turn each section on or off.
claims.quote: You’re always in control, as each section can be turned on or off based on your preferences.

claims.quote: There are no admin controls for these sections.

claims.quote: Searched: MutedChats MeetingChats admin policy; Set-CsTeamsMessagingPolicy Muted sections. Read Manage messaging policies in Teams, cmdlet syntax excerpt, teamworkSection and MC1269864; no tenant switch found.

claims.claim: Beyond the acknowledged Graph beta reference, Learn has no feature page describing the announced user-interface behaviour as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Muted chats Meeting chats sections; Microsoft Teams Muted chats Meeting chats sections tenant admin policy enable disable. Read teamworkSection and Manage messaging policies in Teams; results described Graph or unrelated meeting-chat policies, not the announced UI behaviour.

System-defined sections
MutedChats | The muted chats section.

claims.claim: Chats are moved by the user's own drag and drop.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams chat sections drag drop chats sections user organize. Read MC1269864 and teamworkSection; searched Learn results on organising Teams chats. The notice documents dragging sections, not dragging chats, and no authoritative passage read establishes this sentence.
claims.fix: Replace the bullet with: 'No change: chats are grouped automatically according to the muted-chat and meeting-chat rules described above; users can drag and drop the sections to reorder them.' MC1269864 documents moving sections, not moving chats by drag and drop.

claims.claim: The teamworkSection API represents and operates on sections within an individual user's Teams chat list.
claims.quote: Represents a section in a user's Microsoft Teams chat list that organizes chats, channels, and meetings into custom or system-defined groups.

claims.claim: System-defined sections cannot be deleted through the documented API.
claims.quote: System-defined sections can't be deleted, and only the **sortType** property can be updated.

claims.claim: Only sortType can be updated on system-defined sections through the documented API.
claims.quote: System-defined sections can't be deleted, and only the **sortType** property can be updated. Attempts to update other properties or to delete a system-defined section return `403 Forbidden`.
